profile.headline: Software Engineer at Diameter Health
profile.summary:
Built my Quality Assurance Engineer career over the last eight plus (8.5) years and I have an eagerness to further my personal knowledge in the software testing process and build upon current understanding.  

Broke into the world of automation (certified in Ranorex) and absolutely love it.  Getting more into the technical side of the development process has heightened my love for software and working in this industry.

I love working with automation and coding in general so out of fun I built out an automation framework using Selenium and did it both C# using Visual Studio and in Java using Eclipse.  The test framework I used for C# was NUnit and for Eclipse I used TestNG.  

I have also looked into SpecFlow with Cucumber for .net as another way of writing automated tests and can actually plug in the framework I used in Ranorex and Selenium to build the scripts behind the test cases themselves.  Just continuing to give myself some exposure to many forms of automated testing and development in general. 

Have experience in both Agile and Waterfall development environments.  Work hard to be a great team player and willing to help out in any way that is needed.  I work to be a reason for success instead of a reason for something failing.

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Aided in the beginning efforts of setting up the Automation projects within Ranorex. 
Converted test cases in to C# coded modules within the test suite in Ranorex as well as using XPath to build out the object repo for the project.  Automated Web applications as well as .net desktop applications. 
Also, customized the CSS and XSL files for the Ranorex Reports. 

Worked with GitHub as our source control and visual studio to update our existing repositories.  

Helped maintain the automation environments which included keeping the Jenkins jobs up to date, the VMs updated with the latest java versions to keep the nodes working properly with Jenkins, as well as updated each VM with the latest Ranorex when upgrades were performed. 

Participated in code reviews of the automated C# coded modules. 

Demoed to the team and management the current state of the automation projects.

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
Worked in an Agile environment, participating in daily stand ups, as well as the normal planning and grooming meetings. 

Used MTM with TFS to manage the QA responsibilities of creating, updating, and executing test cases. 

Managed the testing for a couple projects as the lone QA, managing the in sprint test plan, updating the regression test plan and providing the necessary release testing to get latest features out to production.

positions.title: Test Technician
positions.description:
Lead tester on multiple projects, creating, executing, and updating test scripts.

Have performed test manager duties from writing the test plan to testing to the final test report.

Tested web-server and client-server based applications for Financial Accounting, Financial Investment, and Human Resource projects.

positions.title: Video Game Software Tester
positions.description:
Performed overall video game software tests, smoke tests, regression tests and defect verification tests. 

Discovered, researched, and wrote defects.
